title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning with TD3+BC: each arm's chosen configuration on training seeds 2 to 4
description: The search exp-lcf-cost-td3-search-327 chose, by the mean over training seeds 0 and 1 on links 0 to 99 (log utility per 10 ms step minus BBRv3): free at alpha 2.5 with 150,000 updates (-0.176; its clone of BBRv3, lcft-freefix-none, -0.261) and paper at alpha 2.5 with 60,000 updates (-1.270; its clone lcft-paper-none -0.853). Both arms started from their clones scored below the clones on both seeds (best -1.614 and -1.752), so they are not candidates. This run trains the two chosen configurations on seeds 2, 3 and 4 with the recipe of exp-lcf-cost-td3-326 unchanged (expliCCit's actor, critic and window multiplier; TD3+BC, log utility, 10-step returns), so that a later run can score five seeds per arm on links neither search touched.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; ALPHA=2.5; STEPS=60000; FREE='{}'; [ "$ARM" = free ] && { STEPS=150000; FREE='{"inputs": "raw", "encoder": "free"}'; }; O="$OUT/lcftd-$ARM-a$ALPHA-n$((STEPS / 1000))k-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson alpha "$ALPHA" --argjson steps "$STEPS" --argjson free "$FREE" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2: ({algo: "td3bc", action: "multiplier", reward: "log_utility", reward_scale: 1.0, n_step: 10, action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, alpha: $alpha, steps: $steps} + $free)}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| policy | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcftd-*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
